name: What is the difference between renovation, remodeling, and restoration in a high-end context?

mainEntity.name: What is the difference between renovation, remodeling, and restoration in a high-end context?

acceptedAnswer.text: In a high-end context, renovation typically refers to updating an existing space with new finishes and fixtures without significant structural changes, improving its current condition. Remodeling, on the other hand, involves altering the structure or layout of a space, often changing its function or enhancing its footprint. This can include moving walls or adding rooms. Restoration focuses on returning a property to its original or historically accurate state, often involving specialized techniques and materials to preserve historical integrity. Each approach requires distinct expertise and planning.
acceptedAnswer.description: Renovation updates finishes; remodeling changes structure or layout; restoration returns a property to its original state.
